reviews.body:
We are having a great experience with bina since day one. 

Our family love the environment, the teachers, the curriculum and how things flow so well into our routine. We have an open channel with the entire school. We receive feedbacks and updates frequently. 

We travel with some frequency and we work from home so bina fits perfectly with our lifestyle. 
Our daughter is learning much more than when she was in a regular school.

What caught our attention was small class sizes, focus on whole child development, and being able to travel while our daughter still learns. One discovery call and two bina adventures later, we joined the bina family.
bina is our daughter’s only experience of school, and we couldn’t wish for a better reference point for her learning journey. 

We absolutely love our bina experience so far. Our daughter is in class with peers up to three years older than her (because bina focuses on ability, not age). We have seen her confidence, ability to express her natural curiosity, and her engagement with peers really blossom. bina's core values, systems, and processes all align beautifully with what matters to us. We are looking forward to many more biomes on this exciting learning journey.

As two professionals with experience working within education systems, we know how rare and special bina’s approach is. For us, bina is the ecosystem where our child will not only thrive but truly flourish.

Bina has been an absolute game changer for our family. We have twin boys who both attend and are absolutely thriving after coming from a program that wasn’t meeting all of their needs. Bina has been 10/10 with communication, cirriculum , and overall school culture. I could not be more grateful for the hard work of the entire team to make the program what it is. Our family is very proud to be at Bina!

I work at bina in a non-teaching role and it’s the best place I’ve ever worked. There are quirks related to the fast-growing and fully remote nature of the company, but the team is genuinely invested in the students and the mission. I’ve never encountered an organization so understanding of difference and receptive to feedback (even negative), there is a feeling that we are working together to make things better. I’m planning to work at bina for at least 5 years to see where the company goes and I’m proud to say that the teaching team is the best I’ve ever seen, all dedicated to their unique students in distinct and meaningful ways. Can’t say enough good, it’s just the right place for educators who care about kids and meeting them where they are.

bina is a truly exceptional place to work. The healthy work culture is unlike any I've experienced; the entire team genuinely believes in our mission and our students. This passion directly translates to an outstanding learning environment.

bina understands that education isn't a one-size-fits-all model. It offers families the flexibility they need without compromising on the quality of education. Students benefit from smaller class sizes, which allows for more individualized attention, enabling teachers to provide targeted interventions or enrichment opportunities. This personalized approach ensures every student's needs are met. The virtual model allows students to learn from anywhere—be it home or while traveling—giving them access to quality education and resources globally. bina is a flexible, high-quality partner for modern families.

I have been working at bina for over a year now and I am drinking the coolaid :) This is by far one of the coolest, most innovative, dynamic schools i've worked with. The team is phenomenal, knowledgable, non-authoritarian and just good vibes overall! I'm in it for the long run :) The overall community (teachers, admin, parents and mostly kiddos) is what makes bina special. I am honored to be working alongside all of these beautiful people.

Studying at Bina isn't just about traditional education; it's, first and foremost, about the care, support, and love you can only feel in a true family. It’s about genuine children's laughter, a real interest in discovering new things, and even tears – but only because it’s time for holidays. Bina is about true friendship, equality, and respect. It's about teamwork, helping each other, and a sincere desire to make newcomers feel at home. It’s powered by people passionate about what they do – a wonderful team of teachers and managers who become friends to the children. They create unforgettable moments. My daughter talks about them with such excitement and sparkle in her eyes, as if she's just met Santa Claus. This happens after every lesson, every day at school…
These aren't just my words; it’s what I've heard from my daughter, read in her emotions, and seen in her eyes. And children's eyes don't lie. When they're filled with happiness, you, as a parent, will feel it too. Thanks, Bina!

Working at bina has been such a rewarding experience. I’ve worked in international schools in different parts of the world, but I can honestly say bina stands out for its genuine commitment to both children and their families. What’s struck me most is how intentional everything is — from the way learning is designed around hands-on projects that really engage the students, to how technology is thoughtfully used to support individual learning needs. I’ve seen kiddos thrive here who might have been overlooked in a more traditional setup.

Every day at bina reminds me why I chose education — it’s about connecting with each child as an individual and helping them grow in their own unique way. Being part of a team that genuinely cares about making a difference for every student is both inspiring and deeply fulfilling. It’s a privilege to work with a team who love what they do and put their whole hearts into it!

We highly recommend Bina! 

Our son is neurodivergent and was struggling in the traditional schooling system (even though he attended a private school where he received great accommodations). 

We found Bina online when we were researching homeschooling options. 
We are so happy we went with Bina instead. 

Our child has completely blossomed at Bina. And now that he is graduating, he is sad school is ending (when before we would have tears every morning before attending physical school)!

Our son's work ethic has greatly improved. He is more social, more organized and amazes us with his critical thinking skills. 

It's all thanks to the great environment created at Bina: the teachers are wonderful. The other kids are kind, encouraging and great friends to my son. Even though the school in online, they have managed to create a great sense of community. 

I would recommend this school to any parent wanting their kids to reach their full potential!!

We couldn’t be happier with our experience at BINA School! The teachers are incredibly caring, attentive, and dedicated to each child's growth and success. The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to nurture a love for learning while fostering creativity and confidence. My child looks forward to attending school daily and is excited to share everything they’ve learned. The warm, supportive community and emphasis on individual development truly set BINA apart. We’re so grateful to be part of this amazing school!

Bina is fantastic!! Our 6 year old looks forward to school every single day. Worth every single penny!  Bina's marketing and the Admissions staff is impressive. We asked many many questions before we decided to enroll and they were patient, kind and extremely responsive. When we made our decision to enroll, the process was easy and very well organized.  The teachers and staff are WONDERFUL! The curriculum and schedule are excellent - well balanced and tailored to each age group. Plenty of breaks, movement, crafts, focused learning, opportunity for socializing and building friendships and community. The growth we have seen in our child since starting bina is obvious and impressive. Massive leaps in reading, writing, math skills, creativity, social skills (and there was no lack of social skills before bina!), sense of responsibility and so much more.  bina is helping our child grow and learn in ways we couldn't have imagined. We HIGHLY recommend bina!!

I don't often write reviews, but was compelled to after witnessing my child's early experiences of Bina. We have never encountered a more responsive, articulate, enthusiastic and compassionate group of educators in our family's many different educational experiences (including both public and private options). Bina is a forward-thinking, sensitive, and thoughtful environment for children to learn within. It is clearly attracting educators that are passionate about learning and about creating an atmosphere of conversation versus antiquated authority. Bina is about mutual understanding instead of rigid hierarchy.

For kids that might be neurodiverse, that might have trauma from terrible schooling experiences, that might be very bright but have never felt understood before, I cannot recommend Bina strongly enough. Bina educators' approaches to children that might have additional needs, including IEPs, is to actually read and incorporate the recommendations of the IEP.

Working at bina has been a dream come true! I'm thrilled to be part of a school that prioritizes both parents and children. The dedication to supporting each child's learning journey is truly phenomenal. I feel fortunate to be surrounded by such a passionate, international team of educators. Finding a school where every teacher truly loves their work and gives their all is rare. It's invigorating to be on a team that constantly strives for improvement.

Two years ago, I realized that homeschooling my daughter alone was going to be my biggest challenge . So I found Bina!
Their commitment to excellent tailored education to all students is admirable. The Master teachers and all staff members are overly qualified and express genuine care and love to each student. 
The curriculum is broad and covers all areas in a very intuitive, playful and creative ways! Literacy, math, arts, robotics and more importantly for me at this stage, the social emotional learning is the key to our incredible experience at Bina. 
The weekly updates on her development, the micro detailed quarterly assessments, the instant replies to any of my messages, the effort to keep the parents involved, not only in their classroom, but with each other, creates a very respectful, loving family environment to all! 
Thankful to Bina I can raise my daughter near family in Brazil, travel to work in the US and travel Europe with her by my side while getting excellent education!

Bina has been a total game changer for us. Our 4 year old daughter loves it, and she’s learning so much. The teachers are amazing, and the schedule is thoughtfully designed to incorporate lots of screen breaks and movement / activities. Bina allows us to continue travelling without worrying about interrupting our daughter’s education. It gives us flexibility, while providing our daughter with stability and consistency. Highly recommend!

We are so happy that found bina for our daughter. She now loves going to school and is excited to learn! The teachers at bina are incredible and really cater to each child's needs since there are such small class sizes.  The online tools that they use are great for engaging students and really help them learn. Classes are always organized with great projects that the kids are always excited about.

Bina keeps kids engaged with plenty of breaks, perfect for my 5-year-old. Daily activities are well-organized and engaging. Initially, we had to assist with the computer, but our son became independent within weeks. The teachers are exceptional, knowledgeable, and genuinely care about each student's progress, providing personalized attention.
The curriculum is well-rounded, fostering a love for learning. Bina offers extracurricular activities that encourage creativity, critical thinking, and teamwork, helping our child develop new interests and skills.
Communication is excellent, with regular updates, meetings, and quick responses via Telegram groups with teachers and staff. We can meet with teachers as needed, and Bina tailors education to each child.
Bina School excels in providing a well-rounded education, nurturing personal development, and fostering a strong sense of community. We are incredibly grateful for its positive impact on our child's education and development.

I think Bina is one the best online school for children. For me, as father, the most important is my kid's feelings, her happiness to visit school, her bright eyes and smile when she tells me about her day in Bina. She likes lessons and even during her weekend she looks forward to come back to Bina.

When we were looking for an online school for our daughter, it was important to find a place with an individualized approach to each child. Our choice fell on Bina School, and we were not mistaken. The incredible care for the children is evident in everything. Our daughter is thrilled with the interesting projects. She has come to love reading books, learned to work in a team, and is making progress thanks to the attentive teachers. The focus on the child’s emotional well-being is paramount.

Although our child did not know any English before joining Bina, after six months, we have a bilingual child who doesn’t notice whether she watches cartoons in her native language or English. But most importantly, we are delighted with how eagerly our daughter runs to her lessons and how many positive emotions she shares after classes.

This school has been a true revelation for us, and we are immensely grateful for its contribution to our daughter’s development. BINA ONE LOVE ❤️

We could not be happier with bina school. Our 6 year old loves her teachers and classmates and is learning so much better than when she was in traditional school.  It is great for her to have classmates and teachers from all over the world.  The tools and resources they use make learning really fun for our daughter.

reviews.author: Amina
reviews.body: bina has been a blessing for our family, it keeps me closely involved in my son's learning while giving him structure, confidence, and a nurturing school community that shares our values.

reviews.author: Makeda & Steve
reviews.body: We were exhausted and losing connection. Since joining bina, our daughter is calm, confident, and learning joyfully and no more after-school tantrums.

reviews.author: Lorena
reviews.body: My daughter's passion for learning and friendships has grown tremendously. The teachers at bina nurture her independence, confidence, and emotional awareness beautifully.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.body: bina has been a bright spot for our family. The small, live classes and caring teachers helped our children grow in confidence, learning, and connection.

reviews.author: Mo & Ayo
reviews.body: Small classes, whole-child focus, and ability-based learning have helped our daughter's confidence and curiosity blossom. With bina, she thrives and our family flourishes.

reviews.author: Mary Kate
reviews.body: After years of searching for 'a better way' in virtual education, I finally found it with bina, where my boys are seen, supported, and thriving every day.
